name: Benalúa (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Benalúa (a castle, a flower, a tower and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Benalúa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Benalúa arms — castle, flower, tower and tree
